title: CoachPlanDraft
description: AI coach fenced JSON for a training plan draft. Aligns with POST /plans/create body (CreatePlanDto). Each workout `text` must be valid workout DSL.

startDate.description: Agreed preview start date, not activation. Weeks/days are relative to this date.

allowedDays.description: Allowed 1-based day offsets within each plan week, not ISO weekday numbers.

description.description: Human-readable plan explanation. Prefer 2-5 concise sentences covering goal, current training context or baseline assumptions, weekly structure, intended adaptations/effects, and key safety/personalization caveats. Do not put workout DSL/parser instructions here.

structureKind.description: Workout DSL family. Use ENDURANCE for step DSL and STRENGTH for exercise/set DSL.

text.description: Trainingload.ai workout DSL only (parseable). Example: `work 30m` or a multiline repeat block. Prefer multiline repeats over inline comma repeats. Not free-form prose.

notes.description: Athlete-readable natural-language explanation of the complete workout, in the user's language. In roughly 1-3 practical sentences, restate the ordered warm-up, main work, repeats, recovery/rest, cool-down, durations/distances, and intensity/effort cues. For strength include exercises, sets, reps/time, load or RPE/RIR, and rest. It must make sense without reading the DSL text; do not paste DSL or provide only an intent cue.

sportDefinitionCode.description: Use STRENGTH_TRAINING for strength workouts and the exact sport catalog code when known.
